scope: Hand-curated pilot from two public World Bank implementation completion reports; not a portfolio census or automated extraction benchmark.

projects.name: Investing and Innovating for Grassroots Health Service Delivery

indicators.name: Commune health stations meeting structural quality standards
indicators.note: The report distinguishes structural quality from broader care quality; baseline and target were revised.

indicators.name: New commune health stations built
indicators.note: Infrastructure delivered is an output, not evidence of improved patient health.

indicators.name: Health professionals receiving in-service training
indicators.note: Training counts participation, not competency or patient outcomes.

indicators.name: Population utilization rate of commune health stations
indicators.note: Revised baseline is shown; utilization was below the revised target.

indicators.name: Noncommunicable disease cases screened or managed at commune health stations
indicators.note: Screened or managed cases combine different services; original and revised baselines differ.

indicators.name: Hypertension cases managed at commune health stations
indicators.note: Below the revised target; a higher case count does not measure disease control.

indicators.name: Diabetes cases managed at commune health stations
indicators.note: Reported service volume, not clinical control.

indicators.name: Eligible women screened for cervical cancer at commune health stations
indicators.note: Screening count does not establish cancer incidence or mortality change.

indicators.name: Presumptive tuberculosis cases referred for GeneXpert testing
indicators.note: Indicator was dropped; actual is a December 2021 observation, not a completion result.

indicators.name: People receiving essential health, nutrition, and population services
indicators.note: The report explicitly warns that listed subindicators do not add to this total; do not sum them.

indicators.name: Eligible population with effective health coverage
indicators.note: The report describes the target as achieved; coverage is not an independent causal estimate.

indicators.name: Eligible adults with hypertension diagnosed in poorer-health regions
indicators.note: A diagnosis measure; the report says the target was surpassed.

indicators.name: Eligible population enrolled and assigned to a health facility
indicators.note: Empanelment is a mechanism for continuous care, not a direct health outcome.

indicators.name: Eligible pregnant women with early antenatal care
indicators.note: The report describes the end target as achieved.

indicators.name: Eligible women aged 25–64 with a cervical cancer screening
Eligible population with hypertension under treatment
indicators.note: Below the reported end target; treatment is distinct from control.
